title: epilobium leptocarpum subsp. macounii
intro: Epilobium leptocarpum subsp. macounii, commonly known as Macoun's willowherb, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the willowherb family, Onagraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Macoun's willowherb include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and supporting urinary tract health. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
